digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program; observability, gates, migrations, and skill discipline
propositions: Bug provenance must be observable at creation and queryable via bug_trends metrics without new required user input.

Deterministic pre-LLM gates must block raw git writes, unread config fields, unchecked wall-clock asserts, incomplete AC checkboxes, stale code comments, and oversized bug fixes lacking plan-review attestation.
Reconciler transport must be typed end-to-end with declared asymmetries pinned by property tests and pagination deduplicated into shared iterators.
Production shell logic in reconcile-bridge, canary workflows, probe harness, and vote normalizer must be migrated to Python per strangler-fig policy.
Canary and automation bug filing must follow hardened dedup pattern with documented bug-creation contract and valid dedup-key normalization.
Engine-layer validation placement must be advisory-enforced at plan review, and code comments must cite tickets rather than dead SHAs/run-ids/dates with CI regression guards.
